annotations.annotation_text: Dublin geographical anchor (Clontarf): grounding the cosmic oneiric myth in the tangible stone, water, and hills of County Dublin and the River Liffey.
sources: Joyce, P.W. The Origin and History of Irish Names of Places. https://archive.org/details/originandhistory01joycuoft

annotations.annotation_text: The primal text / Mama Livia's Letter retrieved from the Boston dump by Biddy Doran the Hen (Letter), representing the genesis of writing, literature, and decipherment.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish

annotations.annotation_text: Mythological and folkloric archetype (Patrick): invoking the ancient Fianna cycle, heroic legend, and the patron saints of early Celtic Christianity.
sources: MacKillop, James. Dictionary of Celtic Mythology. https://www.oxfordreference.com
